bind(uint256).details: MUST set the bound address to msg.senderMUST lock the token (prevent transfers)MUST emit IdentityBound

params.tokenId: The token ID (caller must be owner)

returns._0: The bound EVM address (zero address if unbound)

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

returns._0: True if the token is bound to an address
The price in wei (0 = not listed)
True if the name has been minted

purchaseMint(string).details: MUST verify msg.value matches the set priceMUST mint the token to msg.sender (unbound)MUST clear the price listing after purchase

rename(uint256,string).details: MUST update name mappingsMUST emit IdentityRenamed

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

returns._0: The bound EVM address (zero if unbound or not registered)
The URL string (empty if not set or not registered)

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setNamePrice(string,uint256,uint8).details: MUST only be callable by authorized policy controller

params.name: The name to price
params.priceInWei: The price in native token wei

setUrlRecord(uint256,string).details: MUST require the token to be boundMUST require caller to be token ownerMUST emit UrlRecordSet

returns._0: tokenId The token ID (reverts if not registered)

unbind(uint256).details: MUST clear bound address, URL record, and lock statusMUST emit IdentityUnbound

returns._0: The URL string (empty if not set)

bind(uint256).notice: Bind the token to the caller's address

boundAddress(uint256).notice: Get the bound address for a token

isBound(uint256).notice: Check if a token is bound (and therefore locked)

nameOf(uint256).notice: Get the name for a token ID

namePrice(string).notice: Get the on-chain price for a name

nameRegistered(string).notice: Check if a name is registered

purchaseMint(string).notice: Purchase and mint a name at the on-chain price

resolveAddress(string).notice: Resolve a name to its bound address

resolveIdentity(string).notice: Resolve a name to its full identity record

resolveUrl(string).notice: Resolve a name to its URL record

setNamePrice(string,uint256,uint8).notice: Set the on-chain price for a name

setUrlRecord(uint256,string).notice: Set the URL record for a bound token

tierOf(uint256).notice: Get the tier of a token

tokenOfName(string).notice: Get the token ID for a registered name

totalMinted().notice: Get the total number of identities minted

treasury().notice: Get the treasury address where purchase funds are sent

unbind(uint256).notice: Unbind an identity (governance action, unlocks for transfer)

urlRecord(uint256).notice: Get the URL record for a token
